༄༅/ /sgyu lus dbang mo che bskur tshul gyi lag len zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sgyu lus dbang mo che bskur tshul gyi lag len zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru/ sgyu lus dbang mo che bskur ba 'dod pa'i go skabs yangs par stegs bu'i steng du rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung zhig 'bri'o/ /de la rgyas pa ni/ phyi nas rim pas mu khyud dkar po dang dmar po dang sngon po gsum gyis bskor ba'i zlum po 'khor yug chen po ste/ de yang phyi dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten dang*/ de'i nang du me ri/ de'i nang rdo rje'i ra ba rnams yod pa mtshon pa yin la/ sku gsung thugs gsum mtshon pa'ang yin no/ /de'i nang du gzhal med khang gru bzhi spyi dang mthun pa/ rtsigs pa'i nang dbus la thugs kyi bar dang*/ phyi'i khyams gnyis kar shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ phyogs mdog yin la/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du tshangs thig gis bcad pa'i re mig bzhi po la/ zlum skor re bya ste/ de yang shar lho'i zlum skor la chos 'byung nyis brtsegs dkar po/ bcad mthing nag /rtsibs mchan dmar po/ dbus su nyi gdan lnga tshoms la/ tshoms bu mthing kha re re bkod/ lho nub kyi grar padma 'dab bzhi'i phyogs mdog / lte bar nyi gdan la tshom bu sngon po/ byang shar gyi grwar chos 'byung dmar po bcad ljang khu gru chad dkar po nub byang gi grwar chos 'byung nag po/ me ri dmar po/ gru chad ljang khu/ zlum bskor bzhi/ bcad kyi mu khyud nag po/ chos 'byung dmar po'i dbus su/ nyi gdan lnga tshoms la/ dbus dkar shar nag / lho ser nub dmar byang ljang ba'i tshoms bu dang*/ chos 'byung nag po'i dbus su nyi gdan la tshoms bu nag po/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus rang du nyi gdan la rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa gcig bri/ 'di bshad tshod la med na'ang bla ma'i phyag len la mdzad do/ /'bring po ni/ 'dod snam pha gu drwa phyed shar bu mda' yab rnams dor te/ rtsigs pa ljang khu/ sgo khyud/ sgo 'gram/ sgo logs/ sgo steng gi gdung dang bcas pa zhig bya/

gzhan snga ma dang 'dra/ bsdus pa ni/ rtsigs pa phan chad mi 'bri bar/ maṇḍal gru bzhi phyogs kyi mdog can la zlum skor bzhi po gong bzhin 'bri/ phyi'i mu khyud gru bzhir re kha dkar po 'bri'o/ /stegs bu de'i mdun du zlum gtor maṃ sas brgyan pa gnyis/ go skabs ci bder/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa rnams dang*/ 'og tu dgos pa'i dbang rdzas dang tshogs kyi yo byad sogs bzhag go /bum pa ni lho nub kyi grwa'i padma 'dab bzhi'i dkyil 'khor der 'jog pa dbang chog las gsungs pa ltar dkyil 'khor rgya khyon chen po yod na/ der mañdzu'i steng du bzhag rgyu yin na'ang*/ phyag len la ni/ dkyil 'khor che na zlum skor bzhi tshom gyi dbus su mañdzu la 'jog kyin 'dug /dkyil 'khor chung ngu la bum pa logs su bshams pa legs/ bum pa ni mgul chings kha rgyan dang bcas pa sogs bshams lugs spyi dang 'dra ba las/ dung chos gzungs thag sogs mi dgos so/ /'di nyid kyi dbang chog las padma 'dab bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la tshom bu lnga 'god pa ltar gsungs shing*/ der lha mi bskyed kyang bum pa'i gdan yin pas bum nang gi lha rnams nyid mtshon pa 'dra ba dang*/ chos 'byung dmar po'i steng du bde mchog lha lnga bskyed pa ltar gsungs shing deng sang yang phal cher yi ge nag 'ded ltar byed la/ lhan thabs kyi yi ge 'ga' re na yang*/ de dang 'dra min tsam bshad kyang*/ bla ma'i zhal nas de rnams man ngag gab pa yin zhing*/ khyad par lhan thabs kyi yi ge na/ padma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma/ mdun du yi dam/ g.yas su 'das pa'i bla ma zhes sogs 'chad pa ni/ shin tu ma dag gsungs/ des na rang lugs zhal bzhes phyag len ni/ chos 'byung nyis brtsegs dang bum pa'i nang du rgyud sde lnga'i gtso bsdus/ padma 'dab bzhi la/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang la mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i bskor ba'am/ bla ma'i ngo bo bde mchog lha lnga/

chos 'byung dmar po'i nang du rdo rje phag mo lha lnga bsgom pa yin no/ /de ltar na sngon 'gro gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bzhin tu btang*/ gnas dang mchod pa byin rlabs kyang bde mchog lha lnga dang 'dra ste/ spyi dang mthun skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ slar yang rang nyid he ru ka yab yum kyi nga rgyal la gnas gsum byin brlabs kyi bar rgyud sde lnga'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa nas bshad pa bzhin/ bdag bskyes bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ de nas mdun bskyed/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swā bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod chen po'i dbus su phyi dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten/ nang bsrung 'khor rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me dpung dang bcas pa'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa 'dod snam dang pha gu dang drwa phyed dang mda' yab la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang phyogs kyi mdog can du gyur ba'i dkyil 'khor dang po'i nang du chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus dang*/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i bum pa'i nang du sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan lnga tshoms su gnas pa'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing kha ind+ra ni la ltar rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan g.yo ba 'phro zhing sgeg pa la chags pa'i nyams can mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa bzhin shin tu 'gyur pas khro gnyer can bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor rus pa'i 'khor lo la gnas pa'i nor bu dang ral pa'i ngos la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pa'i brgyan pa mi rus kyi rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang gdub bu'i tshogs dang*/ ska rags dang mchod phyir thog gis brgyan pa thal ba chen po'i nye bar byugs shing mi mgo skom po lnga'i dbu rgyan/

dpa' bo'i dar dpyang dang bcas pa mi'i rgyu ma la rgyus pa'i khrag 'dzag mgo bo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs bkrol ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po dang*/ g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan dmar mo mnan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /de la 'khyud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo bskal ba'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs thams cad gnon zhing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pa'i yab la 'khyud cing yab yum gnyis ka yang lang tsho gsar du brdo ba me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du gsang ba 'dus pa sku mdog sngon po yid tsam khro ba rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang mtshungs kyis yum la 'khyud pa rdo rje skyil krung gis pad nyi la bzhugs shing dar dang rin po che'i brgyan pa'o/ /lhor dgyes mdzad rdo rje mthing kha phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum bdag med ma sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa skra ser po gyen du brdze ba g.yas brkyang gis pad nyi la tshangs pa dang drag po mnan pa'o/ /nub tu mahā mā ya mthing kha phyag gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pas yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo rang dang mtshungs pa la 'khyud pa skra ser brdzes pa g.yas brkyang gi pad nyi la mi ro mnan pa'o/ /byang du rdo rje 'jigs byed mthing nag ma he'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin pas yum phag mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa skra ser gyen du brdzes shing dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs pa g.yon brkyang gis pad nyi la ma he mnan pa'o/

/ yang dbang chog gi dpe mang po las/ shar du dgyes mdzad/ lhor gsang 'dus bshad pa ltar byas kyang rung ste 'dam kha'o/ / dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i dbus su padma'i lte ba la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gsang ba 'dus pa dang mtshungs pa las yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo 'khyud pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo rnams gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭaṃ ga 'dzin pa g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gsum pa chos 'byung dmar po'i dbus su rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/ nub tu padma mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang mo rnams ḍā ma ru dang thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang mi mgo'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ rang mtshungs kyi 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa'o/ / dkyil 'khor bzhi pa'i dbus su myur mdzad ye shes mgon po zhal gcig phyag drug pa sku mdog nag po phyag g.yas rnams na thod skam gyi 'phreng ba dang*/ gri gug dang ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon rnams na thod khrag dang rtse gsum dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ dgra bgegs dang yi dwags kyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ gtsang rigs kyis mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs rdol dril g.yab mo dang*/ spos dang rol mo sgra chen po dang bcas te/ oṃ hri hā hā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes lan gsum/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa na ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a badzra dhrikka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a hri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/

oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ hrīḥṣtīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇā ni ye badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra mahā ka la kṣiṃ kṣe dra bighnan bi na ya ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ khyad par mgon po la/ kṣiṃḥ mang du brjod pas spyan drangs so/ /de nas dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lan mang du brjod/ gnyis su med par thim/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ yang snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas yum lnga bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ oṃ badzra bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rgyud sde lnga'i gtso bo rnams dang*/ bla ma dang nag po chen po la mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ mkha' 'gro lnga po rnams la rigs lnga so so'i dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas phyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod rnams bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil chog ltar phul/ bstod pa ni/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /thabs kyi khro bo'i skur bstan gdug pa 'dul/ /che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang*/ /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyis/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /thams cad dngos po rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/

/dgyes mdzad rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dur khrod rgyan gyi legs brgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ / thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur ston pa/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa/ /dud kha mun chen khyod la 'dud/ /chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i sku/ /bstan pa'i ru ṭa 'joms mdzad pa/ /nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces sogs kyi bstod/ gtor ma ni/ bdag skyed bzhin bsang sbyangs byin gyis rlabs/ rgyud sde lnga dang*/ rdo rje phag mo dang*/ mgon po'i snying po rnams kyi mthar/ a kā ro/ btags pa lan gsum gsum dang*/ mgon po la/ shā sa na lan gsum gyis kyang phul la/ slar yang arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan 'phrin las rab rdzogs pa/ /dkyil 'khor lnga po thams cad la/ /kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhabs gdub dang bcas bi nā ya ka mnan/ / nag po chen po stag gi sham thabs can/ /phyag drug sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas pa gri gug bar pa phreng ba 'dzin/ /tha mas ḍa ma ru ni drag tu 'khrol/ /g.yon pas thod khrag dang ni mdung rtse gsum/ /de bzhin zhags pa bzung nas 'ching bar byed/ /drag po'i zhal gdangs mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ spyan gsum drag po dbu skra gyen du 'bar/ /dpral bar sindhu ra yis thig le byugs/ /spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab brtan/ khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/

/shing las byon nas gtor ma len mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan phyag drug pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / gi bar 'phrin las bcol/ mdun bskyed dang bum pa la dmigs nas bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i dbang gi dngos gzhi rnams dmigs pas bdag 'jug gi tshul du blangs/ tshogs 'khor byin gyis rlabs pa yang*/ skabs 'dir byas na legs te slob dpon gyi bya ba'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams nang du 'dus pa la/ thog mar bgegs gtor spyi dang 'dra bar btang la bgegs bskrad/ lag len bsdus pa'i skabs/ sngar gyi sngon 'gro'i gtor ma la 'di'i don tshang pas/ bgegs gtor ma btang kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas sems bskyed gsol ba 'debs pa sogs chos dang lo rgyus cung zad bshad/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pas mdzad pa'i sngon 'gro rgyas pa'o/ /mdo tsam logs su 'bri ba ltar sngon 'gro bcu po rnams bya/ de rjes/ da lan gyi skabs 'dir dngos gzhi la btags pa brda' yi dbang bzhi/ thob pa don gyi dbang bzhi/ mthar thug gsang ba'i dbang bzhi ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod dbang bzhi gsum bcu gnyis yod pa las/ thog mar btags pa brda'i dbang bzhi'i don du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/

zhes pas bskul/ slob mas maṇḍal phul/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba gdabs pa 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyabs pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ / lan gsum gyi gsol ba btabs/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la slob ma'i ngor gong bzhin gsal btab/ mdun du bzhugs pa'i/ sku gsang ba 'dus pa/ gsung mahā mā ya/ thugs dgyes mdzad rdo rje/ yon tan 'khor lo sdom pa/ 'phrin las rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ myur mdzad dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis shis pa brjod/ rdo rje phag mo dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pas phyag na bum pa thog nas dbang bskur bas lus kyi sdig sgrib dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūṃ/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams gyis ni khrus gsol ltar*/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā la sha a bhi ṣiñtsi maṃ/ bum pa'i chu rgyun gyis spyi bo'i 'khor lor sleb/ des bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ lus kyis dri ma dag /'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa yab yum thams cad bde ba'i ngo bor zhu/ dkyil 'khor gyis gtso bo rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i cha thams cad rgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas shes rab kyi gsang ba'i mtsho skyes su byon pa'i byang chub kyi sems lce thog tu bzhag par gyur/ nang mchod la bum chu cung zad bsres te/ hūṃ phyogs dus sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yis/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pas/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu hye a bhyi ṣañtsi maṃ/

zhes bdud rtsi sby-in/ bum chu dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis mgrin par slebs/ des gsang dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag / longs sku thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas/ yang bum chu spyi bor gtor la/ khyed rang rnams lha sku yab yum zhal sbyor gyis rnam par gnas pa la thugs rgyud bde ba chen po'i yongs su gang bar gyur/ bum chu'i rgyun dang bdud rtsi snying gar slebs pas/ dbang gsum pa'i ye shes skyes par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra dzña dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas/ yid kyi dri ma dag /'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ yang bum chu gtor/ bum chu dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun lte bar slebs/ lus thams cad gang*/ gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa dbyings su dag par mos la/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag par mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā tsa turtha a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ de'i dbang bzhi pa thob pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag /ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ des btags pa brda' yi dbang bzhi song*/ gnyis pa thob pa don gyis dbang bzhi'i don du maṇḍal phul/ ces bskul/ slob mas maṇḍal phul/ 'di la dbang gdams ngag dang 'brel ba dang*/ gdams ngag dbang dang ma 'brel ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ khyed rang rnams kyis lus dang longs spyod phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul te/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la phul bar mos te/ 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bdag la yang dag par sgyu lus kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyis lha tshogs rnams kyi bdag la yang dag par sgyu lus kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro chos skyongs ba'i srung ma rnams kyis bdag la yang dag par/ sgyu lus kyi dbang bskur du gsol zhu ba dang*/

nyams su len pa la bar chad thams cad bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa lan gsum/ de nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po de las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad oṃ dkar po'i rnam par bsdus/ spyi bo'i oṃ la thim/ oṃ de nyid 'od zer dkar por ldem ldem zhu ste/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ lte bar byon pas de nyid thig le dkar po gcig tu gyur/ de'i 'od kyis lus gang bas khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyang 'od dkar po'i ngo bor ldem ldem 'dug /nyon mongs pa gti mug sangs kyis dag par mos/ de'i rigs 'gres te/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par āḥdamar po de las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad āḥdamar po'i rnam par bsdus/ mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ āḥde nyid 'od zer dmar por ldem ldem zhu ste/ mgrin pa nas zhugs/ lte bar byon pas de nyid thig le dmar po gcig tu gyur/ de'i 'od kyis lus gang bas khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyang 'od dmar po'i ngo bor ldem ldem 'dug /nyon mongs pa 'dod chags sangs kyis dag par mos/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar hūṃ sngon po de las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad hūṃ sngon po'i rnam par bsdus/ thugs ka'i hūṃ la thim/ hūṃ de nyid 'od zer sngon por ldem ldem zhu ste/ thugs ka nas zhugs/ lte bar byon pas de nyid thig le sngon po gcig tu song*/ de'i 'od kyis lus gang bas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyang 'od sngon po'i ngo bor ldem ldem 'dug /nyon mongs pa zhe sdang sangs rgyas dag par mos/ khyed rang rnams kyi lte bar traṃ ser po de las 'od zer ser po 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yon tan gyi byin rlabs thams cad traṃ ser po'i rnam par bsdus/

lte ba'i traṃ la thim/ traṃ de nyid 'od zer ser por ldem ldem zhu ste/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ lte bar byon pas de nyid thig le ser po gcig tu song*/ de'i 'od kyis lus gang bas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyang 'od ser po'i ngo bor ldem ldem 'dug /nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dang ser sna sangs kyis dag par mos/ zhes sogs 'don pa spos/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor a ljang khu de las 'od zer ljang khu 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi 'phrin las thams cad a ljang khu'i rnam par bsdus/ spy-i bo'i a la thim/ a de nyid 'od zer ljang khur ldem ldem zhu ste/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ lte bar byon pas de nyid thig le ljang khu gcig tu song*/ de'i 'od kyis lus gang bas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyang 'od ljang khu'i ngo bor ldem ldem 'dug nyon mongs pa phrag dog sangs kyis dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar na khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid dwangs ma ye shes lnga ldan/ bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gsal seng nger gyur pa la mnyam par bzhag mdzod/ gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i gdan la bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen la yum rdo rje phag mos 'khyud pa/ 'khor mkha' 'gro ma bzhis bskor ba la/ mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag po dang bcas te/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus dang longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge ba'i dngos po dang bcas pa thams cad blos ling gis phul nas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po ches sems can thams cad kyi don du/ bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/ bla ma'i sku'i smin mtshams nas 'od zer dkar po byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi smin phrag tu thim/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag khyed rang rnams kyi lus lha sku gsal stong 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur pa la mnyam par zhog mdzod/

yang gsang ba'i dbang gi don du 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po ches/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/ bla ma yab yum gyi gsang ba'i sbyor mtshams nas/ byang chub sems kyi ngo bo 'od zer dkar dmar 'dres pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi lce la thim pas/ ngag gis dri ma dag /lha sku snga ma las kyang ches gsal bar gyur pa la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ yang shes rab kyi dbang gi don du 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po ches sems can thams cad kyi don du/ bdag la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog sna lnga byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag nas/ lha sku gsal ba rab kyi mthar thug par gyur pa la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ ces brjod/ dbang de gsum re re'i mthar lha sku la cung zad sems 'dzin du 'jug / yang dbang bzhi pa'i don du 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po ches sems can thams cad kyi don du/ bdag la bzhi pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus sems khong klod la gshis cir yang ma grub cing gdangs gang du yang 'gag pa med pa/ thol skyes rang byung gi shes pa so ma 'di la bzo bcos med par lhan ne mnyam par zhog cig / ces brjod la cung zad bsgom du gzhug go / de ni sems spros med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bya ba/ dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes lags so/ /des thob pa don gyi dbang bzhi song*/ gsum pa mthar thug gsang ba'i dbang bzhi zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ zhes bskul la slob mas maṇḍal phul/ de nas mthar thug gsang ba'i dbang bzhi 'di gsum ste/ stong pa'i gzhi 'cha' ba dang*/

rtsa lam sbyang ba dang*/ dag pa'i lha skur bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ khyed rang lha skur gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma kha dog dkar ba/ yar rtse tshangs bug dang*/ mar rtse gsang gnas su zug pa zhig gsal btab/ dbu ma de'i nang snying ga'i thad du a dkar po dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can gsal btab/ ngag tu/ a zhes lan mang du brjod cig byas la/ brjod du gzhug / a las 'od zer 'phros/ thog mar dbu ma dang*/ de nas rang lus gang*/ mthar rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad a yig gi 'od kyis khyab pas/ thams cad 'od du ldem ldem 'dug pa la/ cung zad sems gtad pas/ de rnams kyang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du gyur pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod/ gnyis pa rtsa lam sbyangs ba ni/ yang khyed rang rnams lha skur gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su/ rtsa dbu ma kha dog dkar po yar rtse tshangs bug dang*/ mar rtse gsang gnas su zug pa zhig gsal btab/ dbu ma'i nang spyi bo'i thad du haṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du blta ba/ mgrin pa'i thad du āḥdamar po mgo bo gyen du blta ba/ snying ga'i thad du hūṃ mthing nag mgo bo thur du blta ba/ lte ba'i thad du aṃ dmar ser mgo bo gyen du blta ba/ spyi bo'i haṃ las 'od zer gsal seng gis byung*/ mgrin pa'i āḥl phog de las 'od zer gsal seng gis byung*/ snying ga'i hūṃ la phog /de las 'od zer gsal seng gis byung*/ lte ba'i aṃ la phog /lus sems thams cad bde cham cham song*/ yang 'od zer yar log ste sngar gyi rim pas lugs bzlog tu song ste/ spyi bo'i haṃ gi bar du gsos/ de ltar yas rim dang mas rim du 'phros pa'i 'od zer de rnams kyi rtsa gnas thams cad gang*/ 'khor lo bzhi la sogs pa'i rtsa mdud thams cad grol/ rtsa nang thams cad 'od zer gyis gang ba'i rkyen gyis rtsa rnams kyang 'ja' 'od du ldem ldem 'dug par bsam mo/ / gsum pa lha skur bsgom pa ni/

yang khyed rang rnams bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sku 'ja' tshon lta bur gsal ba'i rdo rje nor bu'i nang du hūṃ sngon po mgo bo gyen du bstan pa/ hūṃ gi rtse mo la thig le dmar po sran ma tsam gyis mtshan pa/ spyi bor haṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa haṃ gi rtse mo la thig le dkar po sran ma tsam gyis mtshan pa/ de nas 'og rlung cung zad 'then pa'i rkyen gyis hūṃ de yar yong bas gsang ba'i dbang po phyi nang bzlog pa bzhin tu/ hūṃ gis 'khrid nas yar byung ste/ hūṃ snying gar slebs nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dag /steng rlung cung zad mnan pas spyi bo'i haṃ snying gar slebs/ nyon mongs pa gti mug dag gnyis po snying gar 'dzoms pas/ zhe sdang rang dag la song bar bsgoms shig / mthar thug gsang ba'i dbang gi skabs der/ de man chad ni sngon 'gro gdams ngag dbang dang 'brel ba zhes bya ba yin la/ da ni dngos gzhi dbang gdams ngag dang ma 'brel pa ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i haṃ yig de thig le dkar po la thim/ snying ka'i hūṃ yig de thig le dmar po la thim/ thig le dkar dmar de gnyis snying gar 'bros 'ded kyi tshul du 'khor ba la sems gtod la 'di thams cad sgyu ma lta bu yin snyam du 'dun pa sbyongs shig /de bum dbang yin/ thig le gnyis po snying gar 'khor bas gcig rjes gcig gis zin pa'i tshul gyis rig rig 'dug pa la sems gtod la sgyu ma'i 'dun pa sbyongs shig /de gsang dbang yin/ de ltar thig le gnyis reg pas lus sems bde bas khyab pa la sems gtod la sgyu ma'i 'dun pa sbyongs shig /de sher dbang yin/ thig le gnyis po gcig la gcig thim nas nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pa'i ngang der gang yang sgom du med bsam du med pa'i tshul/ rig pa gcer bu brten med kyi ngang du rang gar zhog cig /de dbang bzhi pa yin/ spros bral de'i ngang las bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha sku 'ja' tshon lta bu'i zung 'jug tu gsal thob la mnyam par bzhag go

/de dag gis gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod cig /gtso bo'i ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ / lan gsum/ dbang zab mo legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag tu maṇḍal 'bul/ oṃ badzra bhu me a hūṃ/ maṇḍal rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar/ lus longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po thams cad bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la 'bul/ cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyod kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*/ /cha shas kyang ni spyad du gsol/ / lan gsum mo/ / sgyu lus dbang mo che'i dbang legs par thob nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad sogs/ sgrol bar shog / tshogs phud 'bul ba nas/ tshogs lhag gi bar tshogs 'khor gyis bya ba rnams kyang skabs 'dir byed/ rjes chog mchod pa kha gsos/ de nas byin rlabs bya/ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ snying po so so'i mthar 'bru gsum btags nang mchod 'bul/

sangs rgyas kun gyis sku gsung thugs sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya lan bdun bzlas/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ / sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ / sogs/ gshegs su gsol/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig / sogs kyi smon lam btab/ yon tan rab rdzogs sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ dge ba'i tshogs rnams bsags pa kun/ /bdag gir yongs su bzung med par/ /sems can ma lus kun don du/ /chos dbyings bla na med par bsngo/ / sogs kyi bsngo ba bya'o// //zhes sgyu lus dbang mo che'i lag len 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ / maṅga laṃ/ bkra shis/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 224 -- PAGE 225 -- PAGE 209 -
